purpose: One transparent hand-drawn equipment icon per built-in image generation request. This file is an art prompt template, not game content.

references.role: Approved hand-drawn shape, stroke, palette and material reference. Ignore its panels, captions, grid and backdrop.
Final production density and small-size readability reference. Ignore its grid and text.

execution.destination: Use the parent production manifest path for the stable asset ID; this template does not assign filenames.

styleInvariants: Match the approved hand-drawn game icons: rounded readable silhouette, soft dark navy contour, broad clean painted shapes, about three values of shading, restrained hand-painted facets.
The object has simple hand-painted volume, warm cream edge highlights and a small number of controlled material accents.
One whole equipment object, centered and isolated on genuine transparency, with consistent visual weight in a square inventory slot.
Use theme structure in the object itself, not a separate background emblem.
No text, labels, numbers, badge, quality frame, UI panel, border, tile, background, watermark, figure, hand, mannequin, scene, particle cloud, strong bloom, white flare or photoreal metal.
Readable at 32 and 48 pixels; preserve major silhouette instead of adding fine engraving.

standard.label: 常规
standard.shape: Practical rounded surfaces, curved fittings, simple straps and buckles, clear cloth folds, modest metal trim.
standard.motif: One broad curved or leaf-shaped fitting carried through guard, shoulder trim, brim, boot cuff, pendant setting and ring setting.
standard.materials: Warm gray steel, warm leather or cloth, apricot gold trim, one controlled direction-color accent.

omega.label: 方阵
omega.shape: Orderly modules made of rounded square plates, stepped joints and two or three legible segmented structures, still compact and friendly.
omega.motif: Broken square ring or inset square core physically built into the item, never a square background badge.
omega.materials: Blue-gray plate, warm gold connection points, direction-color cloth or core.

primal.label: 原初
primal.shape: Complete usable primordial relic equipment: large curved roots, smooth ivory shell or mineral casing embrace the main structure, organic grown joints and broad curved contour. Not broken ruins.
primal.motif: One bold natural vein, spiral knot or mineral shell, physically forming the equipment fittings instead of vines pasted on ordinary gear.
primal.materials: Warm ivory, deep wood, muted antique gold, one controlled direction-color crystal.

basic.label: 基础
basic.shape: One clear body layer and one theme fitting; simplest recognizable silhouette.
basic.detailBudget: One dominant motif and at most one main inset.

developed.label: 进阶
developed.shape: Preserve the base object, add one second structural layer or a paired side feature, enlarge the defining inset.
developed.detailBudget: Two large structural levels and at most two subordinate ornament groups.

complete.label: 完整
complete.shape: Complete the theme silhouette with a distinctive paired feature and a finished larger fitting; increase structural identity instead of microdetail.
complete.detailBudget: Three large structural levels, no dense jewels or floating fragments.

weapon.label: 武器
weapon.view: One full weapon, diagonal from grip at lower left to functional end at upper right; same orientation across the family.
weapon.occupancy: Longest edge 80 to 86 percent of canvas; do not clip the tip or thicken a narrow blade artificially.
weapon.readability: Separate grip and blade, bow, or staff head clearly.

clothing.label: 衣服
clothing.view: Whole garment from collar and shoulders to hem, front view with gentle volume; no body or mannequin.
clothing.occupancy: Height 76 to 82 percent, width 66 to 78 percent of canvas.
clothing.readability: Collar, shoulder silhouette, waist and hem remain distinct.

helmet.label: 头盔
helmet.view: Complete helmet in a mild three-quarter view facing right, without a head.
helmet.occupancy: Longest edge 76 to 82 percent of canvas.
helmet.readability: Crown, brim or cheek guards, and face opening remain distinct.

boots.label: 鞋子
boots.view: One compact pair of boots pointing right, front boot fully visible and rear cuff and toe readable.
boots.occupancy: Longest edge 76 to 82 percent of canvas.
boots.readability: Shaft, instep, sole and toe recognizable; no glove-like silhouette.

necklace.label: 项链
necklace.view: Front view of complete chain loop and a single hanging pendant, centered.
necklace.occupancy: Height 78 to 84 percent, width 64 to 76 percent of canvas; pendant roughly one third of full height.
necklace.readability: Clearly a necklace, not a freestanding emblem or finger ring; use broad readable chain shapes.

ring.label: 戒指
ring.view: Single finger ring in mild three-quarter view with setting toward the upper right; whole inner opening visible.
ring.occupancy: Longest edge 72 to 80 percent of canvas.
ring.readability: Band and main setting remain distinct; inner opening stays about four pixels across at 32 pixel display.

template: Asset type: one production inventory equipment icon for Abyss Walker.

Input images: Image 1 is the approved hand-drawn style reference; copy its painted contour, material simplification and shape language only. Any further image is a same-family reference, not an edit target unless stated.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background, isolated object with no tile or cast-shadow ground.
Subject: {{objectDescription}}. Slot: {{slotLabel}}. Equipment series: {{seriesLabel}}. Direction: {{directionLabel}}. Visual structural stage: {{visualStageLabel}}.
Set identity: {{setSignature}}. Preserve this same palette, material, fitting shape and motif across this set's six items.
Direction-specific structural progression: {{directionStage}}. Apply the same progression to each slot fitting, not a miniature weapon pasted onto the equipment.

Style/medium: rounded modern cartoon fantasy equipment, hand-painted navy contours, broad clean color shapes, restrained painterly facets, simple three-value volume, soft cream highlights; closely match the approved final skill icon rendering.
Composition/framing: {{slotView}} {{slotOccupancy}} Keep a clear transparent safety margin and stable visual center.
Small-size readability: {{slotReadability}} Legible at 32 and 48 pixels.

Avoid: text, numbers, quality frame, tier badge, background plate, UI panel, watermark, people, hands, mannequin, scene, multiple unrelated objects, cut-off tips, clutter, dense engraving, gritty realism, sharp white glare, strong bloom and floating particle clouds.

checks: same-direction stages visibly different in structure
standard, omega and primal visibly different in silhouette
no text or UI baked into art
no white fringe or stray pixels

directions.motif: paired beveled guards and slender inset ridge
directions.accent: steel gray, cyan blue and apricot gold

directions.label: 锤
directions.weapon: One complete war hammer with a broad rounded head and clear handle
directions.shape: wide rounded block and thick central strap
directions.motif: rounded block fitting with a central compression band
directions.accent: warm iron gray, amber gold and brown leather

directions.label: 斧
directions.weapon: One complete battle axe with a large crescent blade, short modest axe back and a clear handle

directions.motif: crescent trim and one forked leaf fitting

directions.motif: vertical crystal and open twin-wing holder
